purpose: Manual image contact sheets for five currently one-local-photo Quercus cards. Compare diagnostic foliage, terminal bud, bark, acorn shape. Do not alter botanical source name or nativity.

Water oak variable spatulate leaf tips, triangular leaf base and mature acorns

White oak rounded lobes, pale lower leaf surface, buds and acorns
Overcup oak deeply covering acorn cup, characteristic leaf lobes and petioles
